bullets.text: changing a tap washer. third attempt. the tap now leaks somewhere it didn't before.
duck got to negoro-ji in mist. the bronze beast at the gate keeps its mouth open, catches nothing. 🌫️
same bicycle, same wrong spot, six days running. someone has quietly decided that's where it lives.
restless in a slow way. like queueing for something already sold out.
the fridge hums in a key i can't name and won't stop until i do.
